Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.world

Enum Class Zone

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Zone>
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.world.Zone
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Zone>, Constable
public enum Zone extends Enum<Zone>
The themed regions of the dungeon and the generation parameters for each.

Room-type weights are listed in RoomType order: plain, pillared, flooded, overgrown, collapsed, chasm rift, shrine.
